method.units: prices in Divine Orbs; x = ln(price); league day = floor((hour - launch hour)/86400); one price per day = the 21:00 UTC hourly sample (volume-weighted pair ratio, the app's prices_from_page)
method.data: GGG public Currency Exchange history (https://web.poecdn.com/api/currency-exchange/poe2/<hour>), daily 21:00 UTC samples Dec 2024 - Nov 2026 (+09:00 on launch days 0-21) + the app DB ls_price (hours 0-167 of FotV/RoA/FR) and ex_price (hourly since 2026-11-06). Only hours where the item actually traded (units >= 1).

formula.forecast: x_q(D+h) = x(D) + G(item,D,h) + beta(h,liquidity,phase_m(D),sign e) * e + s(item,h) * m_shock * zq(h,liquidity,phase_z(D),q)
formula.item_drift: G(i,g,h) = (n * median_L M_L(i,g,h) + K * Gc(c,g,h)) / (n + K), K = 2.0, n = launches with data at g
formula.category_drift: Gc(c,g,h) = (n * median_L median_{i in c} M_L(i,g,h) + 1 * Gall(g,h)) / (n + 1)
formula.interpolation: G at non-grid days: linear between grid days; before/after the grid: clamped
formula.excess_trend: e = clip(ln(1 + recent_change_pct/100) - G(i, D-7, 7), -1.5, 1.5); only for D >= 7
formula.momentum_fit: beta_up = sum(e+ * y)/sum(e+^2), beta_down = sum(e- * y)/sum(e-^2), y = clip(x(D+h)-x(D)-G, +-1.5), out-of-sample y and e (inner leave-one-launch-out); ridge: + 10 in each denominator; clamped to [-0.9, 0.9]
formula.scale: s(i,h) = sqrt((n * MAD_i^2 + 15.0 * MAD_c^2) / (n + 15.0)), MAD = 1.4826 * median|u - median u| of out-of-sample surprises u = y - beta*e
formula.quantiles: zq = empirical 10/25/50/75/90 % quantiles of u / s(i,h), pooled over items of the same liquidity tier, per horizon and z-phase (tier all = pooled, used for items not in the model)
formula.patch_shock: m_shock = post-jump / normal robust scale of 7-day surprises (1 when no patch)
formula.confidence: item: high = >=4 launches and liquid (median traded value >= 20 div per hourly sample); medium = >=3 launches and not thin (>= 2 div per hourly sample); low otherwise; forecast() lowers it one step before day 3, past the last data day, or with patch_shock

method.liquidity_tiers: liquid: median traded value >= 20 div per hourly sample; medium >= 2; thin below (thin hourly prices jump 50-200% between days on noise alone)
